# Mamba dependency

BiMamba-compatible Mamba source used by this model.
Build with `MAX_JOBS=2 pip install ./third_party/mamba --no-build-isolation` from the repository root after installing PyTorch and causal-conv1d.
Upstream: https://github.com/state-spaces/mamba and https://github.com/hustvl/Vim.
